svg.title: Spectra daily work: context, approval conditions, implementation and readiness
svg.desc: The recommended workflow separates preparation, specification approval, human or agent implementation, and validation. Approval stages advance in order; app work requires valid implementation approval. Route, inspect and change-impact lookups are optional read-only aids. Manual eval is optional and not a prerequisite for verify, which runs release evals itself. Supporting commands do not form required workflow steps. Groups W1 to W5 have matching HTML explanations.
